explanation.random: This number appears randomly with no detectable pattern. Its appearances are independent of previous draws - exactly what you'd expect in a fair lottery.
explanation.clustered: This number tends to appear in clusters - when it shows up, it's more likely to appear again soon. This could be a statistical anomaly or an interesting trend to watch.
explanation.dispersed: This number tends to spread out its appearances - after showing up, it's less likely to appear in the next few draws. The appearances seem more evenly distributed over time.

monteCarlo.title: Reality Check: Is This Normal?
monteCarlo.description: We simulated thousands of lotteries to see if this number's behavior is unusual or just normal randomness.
monteCarlo.explanationText: We ran {{count}} computer-simulated lotteries to see how often this number would typically appear if everything was random.
monteCarlo.verdictAbove: This number appeared {{actual}} times - that's more than the {{max}} times we'd expect in 95% of cases. It's been showing up unusually often!
monteCarlo.verdictBelow: This number appeared only {{actual}} times - that's less than the {{min}} times we'd expect in 95% of cases. It's been unusually quiet.
monteCarlo.verdictNormal: This number appeared within the normal range of {{min}}-{{max}} times. Nothing unusual here - it's behaving as expected.
monteCarlo.verdictHotSubtitle: This number is on fire - appearing way more than expected
monteCarlo.verdictColdSubtitle: This number has been quiet - appearing less than expected
monteCarlo.verdictNormalSubtitle: This number is behaving exactly as expected

interpretationDescription.above_expected: This number is showing up more often than our simulations predicted - it's on a hot streak!
interpretationDescription.below_expected: This number is showing up less often than our simulations predicted - it's been cold lately.
interpretationDescription.within_expected: This number is appearing at a normal rate - nothing unusual compared to random chance.
